svg.title: The workspace layer
svg.desc: A section through org-workspace: the Claude Code session opens at the top, in a plain folder with no .git. Inside it, a warm band of workspace memory files sits above a row of ordinary, untouched git repos, each keeping its own .claude/ state. Nothing connects the two bands: no submodules, no workspace build, no lockfile.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace
Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: the session opens here, one level above every repo
